svg.title: Read the dates and plan renewal
svg.desc: Genuine VMware lab screenshot with numbered annotation overlays. 1. v1 has a real NotAfter timestamp; record its timezone and owner. 2. v2 is a separately issued replacement-key certificate; compare its serial. 3. -checkend 2592000 checks the next 30 days. Monitor the live endpoint too.
svg.text: GENUINE LAB CAPTURE · ALMALINUX 10.2 · NUMBERED ANNOTATIONS
Read the dates and plan renewal
